card.headline: AI is a tool, not the pitch.
card.body: The product is a fixed operation. Agents are part of how it runs.

alt: Dark card reading: AI is a tool, not the pitch.
linkedin:
Is TRACE just AI consulting? No.

AI is a tool we use where it earns its place. It is not the product and it is not the pitch.

The product is a fixed operation. When AI agents are part of the fix, they are part of how it runs, next to the people and processes they support.

If a spreadsheet solves it, you get a spreadsheet.

See how we work at tracestrategies.com.
